pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area is maximum along the lateral neck and mid-flank, exhibiting a transition to smaller, more condensed geometries with jagged perimeters on the distal hind limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned network forming a topological graph with primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the neck but narrows and becomes more fragmented on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck ridge, consisting of dense, upright hair bundles creating a jagged 1D geometric contour against the sky/background.

other_distinctive_markers: Internal dendritic or lacy light-colored striations are visible within the centers of specific dark patches on the lower posterior flank, creating a nested fractal-like sub-pattern.
